cues: That internal friction in a fluid is viscosity.
Picture a liquid between a fixed table and a plate dragged along the top.
The liquid moves in thin layers.
The layer touching the table stays still.
The layer touching the plate moves with it.
Each layer slides over the next, dragging on its neighbours.
text: Pour honey and pour water. Both flow, but honey drags. That internal friction in a fluid is viscosity. Picture a liquid between a fixed table and a plate dragged along the top. The liquid moves in thin layers. The layer touching the table stays still. The layer touching the plate moves with it. Each layer slides over the next, dragging on its neighbours.
